acceptance_results.evidence: project_leases project_id PK; LeaseService.acquire uses SELECT ... FOR UPDATE and raises LeaseHeld for a live other owner; ProjectSupervisor._claim_project claims before constructing any seat. Independent re-review PASS.

Takeover increments epoch. All deterministic DAG-mutation and start-execution entry points, plus the expanded scientific/execution side-effect handlers, check owner+epoch, released_at and expires_at before writing or submitting. Stale-owner tests pass; a brief snapshot cannot be upgraded by a later owner write; binding-scoped brief files prevent overwrite while an old server runs. Independent re-review PASS.

Temporal workflow id includes node and contract version with REJECT_DUPLICATE; the takeover regression uses a real backend_jobs row and real ExecutionReconciler, refuses stale A without a submission, and leaves job count at one. Independent re-review PASS.
One lease row per project; different projects are independent; PAUSED filtering and the existing role checks remain in front of the new lease gate. Independent re-review PASS.

findings.trigger: takeover between the read-only lease check and the later write/submission
findings.impact: small TOCTOU window; duplicate workflows remain bounded by workflow id + reconciliation
findings.required_fix: Hardening: recheck or lock project_leases in the write transaction and immediately before start_workflow. Not blocking AC2 because the deterministic stale case is refused.

findings.trigger: shared role overlay filename per project/role
findings.impact: narrow path where a new owner's overlay could be read by an old process that has not started its harness yet
findings.required_fix: Binding-scope the overlay filename like the brief; tracked as residual risk.

findings.trigger: bool accepted as lease_epoch; binding_id not persisted in PostgreSQL
findings.impact: brief is supervisor-written; owner+epoch from project_leases remains authoritative
findings.required_fix: Reject bool explicitly and add a PG binding row if a later task requires binding-level revocation.

findings.trigger: headless e2e seat does not renew its lease and ProjectLoop has no lease_guard
findings.impact: test-only flake risk for e2e runs longer than the 60s TTL; the real fence still refuses a stale side effect
findings.required_fix: Renew or reacquire in long headless runs; not a production path.

residual_risks: P2 check-to-write TOCTOU remains; deterministic stale-binding refusal is proven, but atomic hardening is not implemented.
Shared ROLE_PATCH_NAME overlay is the remaining shared-path edge.
A concurrent first-ever acquire on a missing lease row can surface IntegrityError; the supervisor retries on the next tick and no second authority is granted.
Long turns beyond TTL fail closed at the next side-effect entry point rather than writing.
The P10-W14 full-file failure was a run-timing flake, not a fence refusal; the test does not call an MCP handler.
